release_notes: V14.44 build 255 adds a user-configurable NO DATA timeout from 5 to 30 minutes beneath the patient-name setting. When the selected glucose-age limit is reached, the display performs a fresh Nightscout verification before declaring NO DATA. It distinguishes confirmed stale glucose from an unreachable Nightscout service and retries verification before activating the NO DATA alarm. This build also corrects the verification compile path by returning the Nightscout read result from updateLatestGlucose. The working OLED242-style mDNS alias sequence, Web OTA progress, OTA TLS retry correction, 30-minute trend recovery, buzzer controls, alarms, WhatsApp alerts, IOB, COB and ketone functions remain preserved.
